testcases.name: qwen35-4b
testcases.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer in one word.
testcases.notes: Qwen3.5-4B shares the Qwen3.5 architecture and the qwen3_5_hybrid_mamba_attention runtime strategy with the existing 9B profile, and adds a single-GPU configuration that fits 24 GB-class devices. The case passes on the shared text_generation_causal threshold defaults, so this manifest declares no threshold overrides. CUDA graphs stay disabled to match the sibling 9B case; the graph-enabled variant was not measured.
